Your dog’s health doesn’t end at the vet’s office.
Welcome to The Vet Gap — the place for dog lovers who feel frustrated, dismissed, or out of options.
Here, you’ll uncover the natural solutions, mobility strategies, and holistic care your vet never mentioned. From joint pain and arthritis to neurological decline and anxiety, we bridge the gap between conventional vet care and what your dog actually needs to thrive.

💡 Weekly videos. No fluff. No pressure. Just what works — at home, on your time.

	Because your dog deserves more than a diagnosis.
       .Degenerative Myelopathy, spinal cord injuries, stroke, paralysis, arthritis, hip dysplasia
	Natural remedies. Real results.

	📌 Subscribe now and start seeing the difference.

Debi Famelos is the founder of The Canine Bowen Institute and the Creator of Response5.
Please visit https://www.response5.com/site/home and discover for yourself how Response5 gives YOU the lifelong skill to restore your dogs neurological health.
